system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: Ham Radio (Amateur Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Tech-savvy hobbyists, often older but highly active, who spend thousands on gear and take immense pride in their custom callsigns, QSL cards, and technical setups.
product_angles: Customizable QSL Card templates (Canva/SVG) for physical exchange
Highly specialized Ham Radio Operator Logbooks (Amazon KDP) with custom UTC/frequency/mode grid layouts
Patent-style schematic wall art of historic transmitters (POD Redbubble/Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: A highly technical, sleekly designed 120-page amateur radio logbook with dedicated columns for signal reports (RST), power (W), and band/mode, optimized for KDP.

proposals.name: Godot Engine 4.x Visual Assets & Shaders
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie game developers migrating from Unity to Godot who need rapid visual prototyping tools, procedural shaders, and UI themes that fit the Godot 4 ecosystem.
product_angles: Ready-to-use 2D particle effect sheets (fire, magic, smoke) with Godot scene files
Clean, minimalist sci-fi/fantasy UI kits pre-configured for Godot's control nodes
Handmade tileable pixel-art normal maps for dynamic 2D lighting
proposals.first_test_product: A pack of 15 modular retro-futuristic sci-fi UI panels and buttons optimized for Godot's UI system, distributed on itch.io and Cults3D/Etsy.

proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA)
proposals.buyer_persona: Martial artists studying historical fencing books (Fechtbücher). They love historical accuracy, vintage woodcuts, sword anatomy, and need tools to track their sparring and tournament training.
product_angles: HEMA Sparring & Tournament Logbooks with fencing strip diagrams and technique trackers
Restored and upscaled high-resolution medieval fencing woodcut posters (Liechtenauer/Fiore systems)
Technical sword anatomy and guard diagrams for gym wall decor
proposals.first_test_product: A dedicated HEMA Fencing Journal featuring vintage 15th-century master woodcuts on the cover and structured pages for recording sparring sessions, weapon specs, and tournament progression.

proposals.name: Specialty Coffee Microroasters B2B
proposals.buyer_persona: Independent coffee roasters and specialty coffee shop owners who need aesthetic, modern branding materials, flavor wheels, and customer engagement merchandise on a budget.
product_angles: Customizable minimalist coffee bag label templates (Canva links sold on Etsy)
Printable 'Coffee Tasting Journals' that cafes can custom-brand and sell to their retail customers
Modern educational flavor-wheel posters for coffee shop decor
proposals.first_test_product: A bundle of 5 minimalist, editable Canva templates for specialty coffee bag labels (front & back with origin, altitude, process, and tasting notes grids).

proposals.name: Soil Scientists, Geologists & Agronomists
proposals.buyer_persona: Academic and field professionals working in soil science, geology, and agriculture. They have highly specific insider humor revolving around soil horizons (O, A, E, B, C), the Munsell color system, and sedimentology.
product_angles: Humorous apparel referencing 'O-Horizon' or 'Munsell Soil Color Chart' color swatches
Technical geological stratigraphic column posters for laboratory and university office walls
Field notebook covers disguised as classic geological survey documents
proposals.first_test_product: A Munsell-inspired color chart parody poster or t-shirt substituting soil colors with humorous field-work descriptions, targeted at environmental science graduates.

proposals.name: 1-Bit Retro Handheld Console Assets (Playdate)
proposals.buyer_persona: Indie developers creating games for the Playdate console or retro systems that require strict 1-bit (black & white only, no transparency/gray) tilemaps, fonts, and UI assets.
product_angles: 1-Bit (black and white) dithered tilesets for side-scrollers or RPGs
Pixel-art font packs optimized for extremely low-resolution screens (e.g., 400x240)
1-bit animated sprite sheets for character actions (running, jumping, attacking)
proposals.first_test_product: A comprehensive 16x16 pixel 1-bit dungeon tileset with dithered shading, perfectly optimized for the Playdate screen resolution and constraints.
